entities.summary: Wahhabi, a notable figure in the history of Saudi Arabia, associated with First Saudi State and Wahhabi Movement (1773–1818). Preceded by First Saudi Expansion and Destruction and Ibn Saud-Wahhab Pact. Their legacy influenced Saudi-Wahhabi forces capture Mecca and Medina.
